regions.today: A very warm and dry afternoon and evening. Sunny in most areas. A bit more cloud in western parts of Leinster. Highest temperatures of 22 to 29 degrees, warmest in the south, with light northeast breezes.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with mostly clear skies. Temperatures will not fall below 13 to 17 degrees with light, occasionally moderate northerly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Dry and sunny tomorrow with highest temperatures of 23 to 29 degrees in mostly light to moderate northerly breezes.
